newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tyndall optimistic on year, stocks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tyndall optimistic on year, stocks.

text.p: Financial services group Tyndall Australia Ltd is optimistic about its calendar 1996 results after its 24 percent jump in half year net profit, managing director Michael Wilkins said on Wednesday.
"We're pretty optimistic about how the year will pan out but it's dependent on how the markets hold up for us," he told reporters.
Tyndall earlier reported net profit rose to A$8.15 million in the half ended June 30 from A$6.58 million a year earlier.
In 1995, the group earned a net profit of A$17.08 million.
Wilkins said the company was bullish about the Australian financial markets, particularly the share market.
"We're pretty bullish about that, certainly as far as Australian shares are concerned," he said.
Tyndall is 52 percent owned by Sir Ron Brierley's Guinness Peat Group Plc.
